name: N,α-diethylbenzeneethanamine
aliases: 2-ethylamino-1-phenylbutane, EAPB, ethylphenylbutanamine, N-ethyl-1-phenylbutan-2-amine, N,alpha-diethylbenzeneethanamine, N,alpha-diethylphenylethylamine, N,α-DEPEA
summary: N,α-Diethylphenethylamine (DEPEA or NADEP), also known as 2-ethylamino-1-phenylbutane (EAPB) is a stimulant drug of the phenylisobutylamine (α-ethylphenethylamine) group. It is a close chemical analog of methamphetamine, and has been sold as a designer drug. It was originally patented by Knoll Pharma as one of several analogs for pharmaceutical applications.
